title: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana – Rajasthan Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Rajasthan government health assurance programme providing cashless treatment for eligible residents under the current state health protection framework.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on Rajasthan's current notified beneficiary categories, registration/enrolment and applicable state rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana – Rajasthan.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
